title: Stability of a homogeneous Gaussian halfspace
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $a\in\mathbb R^n$ satisfy $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^2=1$. For every $\rho\in[-1,1]$, the Gaussian noise stability of the sign function $x\mapsto\sigma\!\left(\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i\right)$ is $1-2\arccos(\rho)/\pi$.
